Class UpperPile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.UpperPile
public class UpperPile extends Object
Represents the upper row of cards on the game board. Manages the storage, addition, and shifting of tribe cards and building cards before they are moved to the lower pile or drafted by players.

  • Method Details

    • addCard

      public void addCard(Card card)
      Smartly adds a single card to the pile, automatically routing it to the correct internal list based on its specific type. Used during initial setup and single-card refills.
      Parameters:
      card - The card to be added (TribeCard or BuildingCard).

    • removeAndReturnAllTribeCards

      public List<TribeCard> removeAndReturnAllTribeCards()
      Extracts all tribe cards currently present in the upper row and clears the internal list. This is primarily used during the end-of-round shifting phase to move cards to the lower row.
      Returns:
      A list containing all the tribe cards that were in the upper row.

    • removeAndReturnAllBuildingCards

      public List<BuildingCard> removeAndReturnAllBuildingCards()
      Extracts all building cards currently present in the upper row and clears the internal list. This is primarily used during the end-of-era shifting phase to move buildings to the lower row.
      Returns:
      A list containing all the building cards that were in the upper row.

    • removeCard

      public void removeCard(Card card)
      Removes a specific card from the upper row, determining its type to remove it from the correct internal list. Used when a player successfully drafts a card directly from the upper row.
      Parameters:
      card - The drafted card to remove.

    • getTribeCardsSize

      public int getTribeCardsSize()
      Retrieves the current number of tribe cards in the upper row. Useful for calculating how many cards are needed during a refill.
      Returns:
      The size of the tribe cards list.

    • getAllCards

      public List<Card> getAllCards()
      Retrieves a unified list of all cards (both tribe and building cards) currently present in the upper pile. Primarily used to expose draftable cards to the players.
      Returns:
      A combined list containing all cards in the upper row.

    • getTribeCards

      public List<TribeCard> getTribeCards()

      Returns:
      copy of visible upper tribe cards
